summary: Writes the message as a blob to an Azure Storage container.

properties.name: ContainerName
properties.description: Name of the blob container to upload files to.

properties.name: FileName
properties.description: Name to give the uploaded blob. If empty, a name is generated from the current timestamp and a GUID.

properties.name: FileExtension
properties.description: Extension appended to the generated blob name (e.g. json, csv). Ignored if FileName is set.
